name: Proceso de Paz Fragil
description: Implementacion lenta de los acuerdos de paz. Asesinatos de lideres sociales y excombatientes amenazan la reconciliacion.
description_en: Slow implementation of peace accords. Murders of social leaders and ex-combatants threaten reconciliation.

name: Cultivos de Coca
description: Colombia sigue siendo el mayor productor de cocaina del mundo. Hectareas de coca en niveles historicamente altos.
description_en: Colombia remains the world's largest cocaine producer. Coca hectares at historically high levels.

name: Guerrilla del ELN
description: El ELN mantiene presencia armada en multiples departamentos. Extorsion, secuestro y mineria ilegal financian sus operaciones.
description_en: The ELN maintains armed presence in multiple departments. Extortion, kidnapping, and illegal mining finance their operations.

name: Desplazamiento Interno
description: Mas de 8 millones de desplazados internos, la cifra mas alta de America. Comunidades rurales forzadas a abandonar sus tierras.
description_en: Over 8 million internally displaced persons, the highest figure in the Americas. Rural communities forced to abandon their lands.

name: Desigualdad Extrema
description: Indice Gini de 0.51, el mas alto de America Latina. Brecha abismal entre estratos socioeconomicos y regiones.
description_en: Gini index of 0.51, the highest in Latin America. Abysmal gap between socioeconomic strata and regions.

name: Deforestacion
description: Perdida acelerada de bosques en la Amazonia colombiana. Ganaderia extensiva y mineria ilegal como principales causas.
description_en: Accelerated forest loss in the Colombian Amazon. Extensive cattle ranching and illegal mining as main causes.

name: Corrupcion
description: Sobornos y clientelismo politico arraigados en la cultura institucional. Billones de pesos desviados de obras publicas.
description_en: Bribery and political clientelism rooted in institutional culture. Billions of pesos diverted from public works.

name: Migracion Venezolana
description: Mas de 2.8 millones de venezolanos en Colombia. Presion sobre servicios publicos, empleo y vivienda en ciudades receptoras.
description_en: Over 2.8 million Venezuelans in Colombia. Pressure on public services, employment, and housing in receiving cities.
